changeRecord.title: member rolled 90 degrees (weak axis)
changeRecord.whyItMatters: The roll angle decides which principal axis of the section resists the bending. Rolled by 90 degrees an I-shape bends about its weak axis: for typical beam shapes the stiffness drops by a factor of 10 to 30 and the flexural strength by 3 to 6; a column turned the wrong way buckles and sways about the wrong axis. Loads given in member local axes turn with the member.
